ResourcePolicy.note: get-policy returned ResourceNotFoundException = NO resource-based policy at rest. EventBridge Scheduler invokes via its TargetRoleArn (an IAM role with lambda:InvokeFunction), NOT via a resource policy. deploy.py must create that scheduler execution role instead of an AddPermission statement.
